snippet.title: OUT NOW | BR 194 and E94 Gameplay Pack Trailer - Train Sim World 5
snippet.description:
Head back to 1984 or bring history to the 21st Century with TSG's BR 194 / E94 Railtour Pack, out now! 

The pack brings two more variants of this iconic style of locomotive to German route Add-ons, following the inclusion of the ÖBB 1020 in the Mittenwaldbahn route Add-on. Two Scenarios will be playable on both Linke Rheinstrecke and Pfälzische Ludwigsbahn.

Discover more via https://bit.ly/e94-tsg-out-now-4

Available on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Epic Games and Steam 

---------------------------------------------------------------
Train Sim World 5 is available now on PlayStation, Xbox, Steam and Epic Games Store! 

Find out more about Train Sim World 5 here: https://bit.ly/TSW5-e
